title: Software Engineer -ios
description:

title: Senior Android Platform Security Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**About the Job**

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Android Platform Security team, you will architect, design, develop, and validate critical hardware-backed security modules that protect billions of Android devices worldwide. You will work across the entire Android security stack—from Java framework APIs and Rust/C++ system daemons (keystore2) down to AIDL Hardware Abstraction Layers (HALs), Trusted Execution Environments (Trusty OS), and Secure Elements (JavaCard / StrongBox).

In this role, you will lead complex features involving cryptographic key management, hardware attestation, Remote Key Provisioning (RKP), and compliance verification through CTS and VTS suites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design & Development**: Architect, develop, and maintain core Android security components including Android Keystore, KeyMint (and StrongBox KeyMint), Trusty OS Trusted Applications (TAs), and JavaCard applets for Secure Elements (eSE).
* **HAL & IPC Integration**: Define, implement, and evolve AIDL-based HALs and Binder IPC interfaces connecting the Android OS framework with underlying TEE and Secure Element hardware.
* **Cryptography & PKI**: Implement and review cryptographic protocols, hardware-backed key generation, key attestation, X.509 certificate chain validation, and secure storage mechanisms.
* **Testing & Compliance**: Author, maintain, and debug CTS (Compatibility Test Suite) and VTS (Vendor Test Suite) tests to ensure ecosystem-wide security compliance and robustness across SoC vendors and OEMs.
* **Cross-Stack Debugging:** Triage, root-cause, and resolve complex functional, performance, and security issues spanning Java framework services, native C++/Rust system daemons, kernel drivers, TEEs, and Secure Elements.
* **Technical Leadership**: Provide technical mentorship, drive security design reviews, Threat Modeling, and code reviews in C++, Rust, and Java, ensuring adherence to memory safety and secure coding best practices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience**: 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in embedded systems, OS internals, or mobile platform security.
* **Programming Languages**: Strong proficiency in C++, Rust, and Java (including JavaCard for Secure Element applet development where applicable).
* **Android Security Core**: Deep hands-on experience with Android Keystore, KeyMint (or Keymaster), Trusty OS (or equivalent TEEs like OP-TEE/QTEE), and Secure Elements (eSE / StrongBox).
* **Interfaces**: Proven experience developing and integrating Android HALs using AIDL (and HIDL) and Binder IPC.
* **Cryptography**: Solid foundation in applied cryptography (AES, RSA, ECC/ECDSA/ECDH, SHA/HMAC, KDFs), PKI, X.509 certificates, and hardware key attestation.
* **Validation**: Hands-on experience developing, executing, and debugging Android CTS and VTS test suites.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **Rust in AOSP** (e.g., keystore2, KeyMint Rust reference implementation, or Trusty Rust TAs).
* Experience with **JavaCard** applet development, GlobalPlatform specifications, APDU command protocols, and OMAPI.
* Knowledge of **Remote Key Provisioning (RKP)**, CBOR/COSE data structures, DICE (Device Identifier Composition Engine), or Android Virtualization Framework (AVF / pKVM).
* Familiarity with side-channel mitigation, fuzz testing (libFuzzer), static/dynamic analysis tools, and hardware security certification standards.
* Track record of contributing to the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) and collaborating with SoC vendors, OEMs, or Secure Element vendors.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

title: Lead Mobile Developer (Remote)
description:
**About DigitalTolk**

DigitalTolk is an organization and company that works to make an impact. Our purpose is to give a voice to those who don’t speak the local language; we arrange translators so that patients can get medical treatments in their new country and communicate with doctors. We arrange translators for crime victims so that they can get justice. Our job is to arrange interpreters through our platform for our customers.

Our end customers are hospitals, courts/lawyers, and municipalities who communicate with refugees and other people in need.

Our company purpose is to use technology to make the world a better place. And we’re currently hiring developers to join us on this journey!

We are a company based in Sweden with developers in all parts of the planet!  
  
We're looking for an experienced **Lead Mobile Developer** to join our fully remote engineering team.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with 5–10 years of experience building and maintaining mobile applications. You'll lead the development of our mobile platform, help shape technical decisions, and work closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.

Our mobile applications are primarily built with Vue.js/Capacitor, but we're looking for someone who is also comfortable working with native iOS (Swift) and Android (Java/Kotlin) when needed. We're also interested in engineers who have adopted modern AI-assisted development tools, particularly Claude, as part of their daily workflow to improve productivity and code quality.

**What you'll be doing**

* Lead the development and maintenance of our Vue.js/Capacitor applications for iOS and Android.

* Build new features, improve existing functionality, and ensure the apps remain stable and performant.

* Contribute to native development using Swift and Java/Kotlin whenever required.

* Take ownership of mobile releases, including App Store and Google Play submissions.

* Monitor application health using tools such as Sentry and Firebase Crashlytics.

* Investigate, reslove and production issues quickly.

* Review code, mentor other developers, and support the team with technical guidance.

* Work closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineers throughout the development process.

* Improve our development, testing, and deployment workflows.

* Use AI tools such as Claude to assist with development, debugging, documentation, and code reviews where appropriate.

**What we're looking for**

* 5–10 years of professional software development experience.

* Strong commercial experience with Vue.js/React Native.

* Solid experience developing native iOS applications using Swift.

* Experience developing Android applications using Java and/or Kotlin.

* Experience publishing and maintaining apps on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.

* Experience integrating REST APIs.

* Familiarity with Redux, Context API, or other state management libraries.

* Experience with Git and modern development workflows.

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions, or similar.

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools, especially Claude.

* Previous experience leading projects or mentoring developers.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote team.

**Why join us?**

* Fully remote position.

* Opportunity to lead the mobile engineering function.

* Work with modern technologies and AI-powered development tools.

* Be part of a collaborative international engineering team where your ideas and technical decisions have a real impact.

title: iOS Developer - Contract Role
description:
**About Nexus**
---------------

You don't have an AI story if you don't have your data story. That's where NexusOne comes in.

We're the converged data platform for the AI era — composable by design, built on an open-source foundation, and AI-native from the ground up. One identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. For the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give AI agents full context across the estate.

What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip-and-replace. No multi-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85+ open-source tools pre-integrated. AI-native automations that deploy and self-heal the stack without human toil. Forward-deployed engineers who build shoulder-to-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.

It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%+ of US small businesses — 40M+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank.

We're 100+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.

Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8g50sv5GhQ

We are looking for a contractual iOS Developer.  
Location- Remote, India

Duration - 6 months.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own iOS features end to end, from design handoff through development, testing, and release.
* Design, build, and maintain native iOS apps in Swift using SwiftUI and UIKit.
* Turn Figma designs into smooth, accessible, pixel-accurate interfaces.
* Connect the app to backend services: integrate REST and GraphQL APIs, handle authentication (OAuth/JWT), error handling, caching, and offline states.
* Work with backend engineers to define API contracts and test endpoints with tools such as Postman or Charles Proxy.
* Write unit and UI tests with XCTest and keep the codebase clean and modular.
* Set up code signing, certificates, and provisioning profiles, and manage builds in Xcode.
* Maintain separate QA, UAT, and production builds using Xcode schemes and build configurations, following a branch-per-environment workflow.

### **Required qualifications**

* 6+ years of professional iOS development experience with at least one app live on the App Store.
* Hands-on experience taking apps from design to deployment, including TestFlight beta distribution and App Store submission.
* Proven experience integrating RESTful APIs into iOS apps using URLSession or Alamofire, with JSON parsing via Codable.
* Strong proficiency in Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit.
* Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, or TCA.
* Experience with Swift Concurrency (async/await), Combine, and Core Data or SwiftData.
* Familiarity with Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and accessibility standards.
* Experience with Xcode, Swift Package Manager, and Git hosted on Azure DevOps Repos.

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with CI/CD for mobile (Xcode Cloud, Fastlane, Bitrise, or GitHub Actions).
* Knowledge of push notifications, in-app purchases, widgets, or App Clips.
* Exposure to Objective-C codebases.
* Familiarity with analytics, feature flags, and A/B testing.
* Contributions to open-source Swift projects or a strong portfolio of apps.
* Familiarity with the backend stack the app connects to: .NET 8 APIs and PostgreSQL.

**Why You’ll Love Working at Nexus**
------------------------------------

At Nexus, we value people who want to grow — and support each other while doing so.

You can expect:

* A collaborative team culture built on curiosity and respect
* Challenging work where your contributions clearly matter
* A leadership team that invests in learning and development
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud, data, and AI innovation

**Ready to Apply?**
-------------------

If this role sounds like a great fit — or even *close* to one — we’d love to hear from you. We know that no candidate checks every single box, and we’re excited to meet people who bring curiosity, talent, and a desire to build meaningful work together.

title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
description:
**Location:** 100% Remote  
**Employment:** Full-time, long-term position  
**Start date:** As soon as possible after selection and agreement  
**Salary:** Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

**About Us**

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
* Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
* Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
* Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
* Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
* Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
* Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
* Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
* Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
* Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
* A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
* The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
* Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
* The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
* BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
* UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
* NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
* Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
* Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
* The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
* Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

**Remote Working Arrangement**

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

* Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
* Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
* The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
* Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

description:

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

title: Software Engineer - IOS
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is looking for a motivated Software Engineer (P2\) to help build and refine our native iOS application. Docusign is redefining how the world handles agreements, moving beyond e\-signatures to a platform that makes agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across the entire agreement lifecycle. Our team's charter is twofold: to support the complex, high\-volume use cases of our enterprise customers while maintaining the world\-class usability and polish that consumers expect from top App Store applications. As a P2 engineer, you will focus on building user\-facing application features, fixing bugs, and improving app performance. You will write clean Swift code, write unit tests, and work alongside senior engineers to grow your technical skills in a collaborative Agile environment.

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Engineering Manager.  

  



**Responsibility**


* Design and build engaging, native user experiences for the Docusign iOS app using Swift
* Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests to ensure high performance and application stability
* Work closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA, and backend engineers to turn feature requirements into working mobile software
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks reported by users or automated tools
* Actively participate in team sprint planning, daily standups, and code reviews to give and receive constructive feedback
* Stay updated with new Apple features, tools, and iOS updates to help continuous team improvement
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**


* B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 1\+ years writing native iOS applications in Swift
* Understanding of iOS application lifecycle, data persistence, network communication with RESTful APIs, and Git version control
* Experience working within an Agile/Scrum team environment

**Preferred**


* Personal or professional app published in the Apple App Store
* Familiarity with SwiftUI alongside UIKit
* Understanding of modern architectural patterns like MVVM
* Exposure to automated testing using XCTest
* Passion for high\-quality UI/UX and Apple Human Interface Guidelines

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
